market.title: ECloe Market
market.syntheticCopy: Products, prices, stock, and orders are simulated. No real money is processed.
market.heroTitle: Synthetic marketplace integrated with ECloe Pay
market.heroCopy: Explore simulated products and the visual foundation for cart, checkout, and recommendations.
market.recommendationPrivacy: Ranking uses aggregated context only. Sex and gender are not collected or used.
market.deliveryDemo: Demo delivery to a synthetic address
market.dailyDealsCopy: Curated demo offers with reproducible prices.
market.payBenefitCopy: Wallet benefits are simulated and appear only at checkout.
market.safeDemoCopy: No real money is processed; no real purchase, payment, or financial credential is accepted.
market.noResults: No products found for the current filters.
market.syntheticProduct: Synthetic item with no real commercial value.
market.addedToCart: Item added to the demo cart.
market.emptyCartCopy: Browse synthetic products and add an item to prepare the checkout demo.
market.cartDemoCopy: This cart is synthetic and stored only for the demo browsing session.
market.checkoutCopy: Review the synthetic items in your cart before creating the demo order.
market.checkoutDemoCopy: No real payment is processed. This creates a payment-pending demo order.
market.plannedCopy: This screen belongs to the next slice: cart, checkout, orders, and transactional ECloe Pay integration.
market.publicCheckoutCopy: You can browse the market without login. The account is requested only when continuing to checkout.
market.loggedInCopy: The current authenticated session will be reused when checkout is available.
market.summaryCopy: The full summary will connect checkout, simulated payment, updated balance, and Engine reward.
